name: web-forager
description: Clean-room, robots-aware web fetching for academic research. Fetch a URL or search keywords through 360/Bing/Sogou, extract article text, tables, bibliographic metadata and PDF text, convert HTML to Markdown, browse Bilibili (feed, video, related, surf), and let an agent surf the web link by link with resumable sessions. Optional Playwright rendering for JavaScript-heavy pages.
